تستطبقون (form X)
# تَسْتَطْبِقُونَ (tastaṭbiqūna) /tas.tatˤ.bi.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَطْبَقَ (istaṭbaqa)
# تُسْتَطْبَقُونَ (tustaṭbaqūna) /tus.tatˤ.ba.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَطْبَقَ (istaṭbaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
